{#- The Caravan site's one page shape. Ported from the Mobility Model Zoo's base template on 2026-10-27 (feature 010, R1). Sphinx's templating is Jinja2, the same as the zoo's generator, so the markup came across as written; what changed is where the parts come from — the navigation from the table of contents rather than a hard-coded list, and the body from Sphinx. The stylesheet loop MUST use `pathto(css.filename, 1)`. On the pinned Sphinx, `css_files` holds stylesheet objects rather than strings, and the older `pathto(css, 1)` dies with a theme error that names neither the template nor the line (R1, found by building it). A page asks for the landing shape with `layout: landing` in its front matter, and `docs/_ext/identity.py` switches it to `landing.html`, which extends this file and overrides `main`. The header, the footer, the skip link and the version line are written once, here, because they are the same on every page. -#} {% block htmltitle %}{% if pagename == root_doc %}{{ docstitle|striptags }}{% else %}{{ title|striptags }} · {{ shorttitle|default(project)|striptags }}{% endif %}{% endblock %} {%- if meta is defined and meta and meta.get('description') %} {%- endif %} {%- if meta is defined and meta and meta.get('robots') %} {%- endif %} {%- for css in css_files %} {%- endfor %} {#- Sphinx's own pages (search, the generated index) extend this layout through the `scripts` and `body` blocks. Scripts load on the search page only: no other page runs any. -#} {%- block scripts %} {%- if pagename == 'search' %}{%- for js in script_files %} {{ js_tag(js) }} {%- endfor %}{%- endif %} {%- endblock %} {%- block extrahead %}{% endblock %} Skip to content
{{ project }}
{#- Two entries, as in Django's documentation: the contents page (from conf.py) and search. Everything else is reached through the contents page. -#} {%- for name, label in nav_pages %} {{ label }} {%- endfor %} Search
{%- block main %}
{% block body %}{{ body }}{% endblock %} {#- Previous and next inside one sequence only, named by title (docs/_ext/identity.py). -#} {%- if seq_prev or seq_next %}
{%- if seq_prev %} Previous{{ seq_prev.title|e }} {%- endif %} {%- if seq_next %} Next{{ seq_next.title|e }} {%- endif %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endblock %}
